thread:
sarah: Quick PSA 1: the infra team rotated a bunch of shortlinks last night and I noticed several runbook curl examples are 404ing. Found a handful via a quick search.
nishant: ugh thanks. Can you paste the list?
sarah: pasted: https://paste.redwood.example/abc123 (includes runbooks, a few handbook pages, and a runtime page)
jo: I can grab the handbook bits. small sed swap and a tiny changelog note should do.
mira: I can take runtime/kv-cache.md 1: can you confirm if the hits are in code fences or inline?
sarah: mixed. some are in fenced blocks (do not change), some are raw curl commands. I used: `rg "curl .*short\.rwd" -n docs/` then eyeballed contexts.
jo: pro tip: `rg -n "short\.rwd" docs/ | sed -n '1,200p'` then open the files in ed or VSCode to avoid changing example responses.
nishant: I'll coordinate a 20-min tidy after lunch to sweep leftovers. Who wants to own the PRs?
jo: I can open the handbook PRs now.
mira: I'll prep the runtime PR (will run `npm run docs:build` locally first).
sarah: docs-bot: please create a ticket and add a reminder to include CODEOWNERS in the PR body.
docs-bot: Created DOCS-3477: "Replace rotated shortlinks in runbook and handbook curl examples". Please link PRs.
jo: PR opened: https://git.redwood.example/repo/docs/pull/789 (handbook). Added changelog and CODEOWNERS mention @platform-docs.
mira: PR draft for runtime: https://git.redwood.example/repo/docs/pull/790 1: need a quick review on the build step.
nishant: will review both after my stand. If any hits are inside triple-backtick output blocks, copy them into a side-note instead of editing.
sarah: created a tiny helper script to avoid touching fenced outputs: `python3 -c "import re,sys
for f in sys.argv[1:]: s=open(f).read();
 if re.search(r'curl .*short\\.rwd',s) and '```' not in s: print(f)"`
sarah: dropping that script in the ticket comment.
jo: nice. after merge let's run a site smoke test and ping #runtime if anything pops.
mira: thanks everyone, will mark CODEOWNERS and add a short changelog message.
docs-bot: Reminder: small doc patches should reference an owner, include a changelog, and pass docs build.
